title: OverlayCue
description: One timed, machine-readable on-screen cue. A template cue airs on detection; a verified agent cue replaces it in the same slot.

slot.description: Screen region or anchor, e.g. lower_third, top_right, player:<id>.

anchor.description: Pixel position on the video frame for cues drawn on the footage.

lang.description: BCP-47 tag, e.g. en, es, ar.

pan.description: Stereo position for a spoken cue, where the play is: -1 the left of the camera's view, 0 the centre, 1 the right.

speech.description: For an audio_description cue: whether its line was spoken, or speech was unavailable and the viewer should show or read the text instead.

fallback.description: Set only when this cue is on air because something failed, saying what: a template graphic that stayed because the agents' claim was held (e.g. "held: timeout"), or a variant from the Personalizer's in-process fallback (e.g. "personalizer: refused"). The viewer shows it as a fallback badge. Absent when nothing failed.
